title: IssueLogEntry
description: One issue-log entry: exactly the sponsor's 16 columns, in this order (Sponsor Deliverables v1.2 s10). Records what the scorer found, never what to change: there is no severity, ranking, owner, fix or recommendation field (Scope Letter Amendment 1 s1). Written by the pipeline, never by the frontend. The file keeps its old name; the concept is an issue-log entry. See docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md.

entry_id.description: run_id plus a five-digit sequence, e.g. run-mock-2026-11-05-00001.

aven_version.description: As supplied with the transcript; null for corpora.

scorer_prompt_version.description: Every prompt version, sorted by name and ;-joined, e.g. globals=globals-v0.2;prohibited=prohibited-v0.2;volley_coder=volley-coder-v0.5.

item.description: MEASURE: the issue-log item name, as the Python scorer writes it (pct_complex_reflections, pct_open_questions, technical_global, relational_global, mi_non_adherent). TABLE_C: C1_reflection_run, C2_window_no_questions or C2_window_no_reflections. TABLE_D: the Table D code.

observed.description: The value found, as text; null for TABLE_D.

threshold.description: The threshold it breached, as text; null for TABLE_D.

scoreability.description: not_scoreable sessions never produce an entry.

turn_start.description: Raw transcript turn, inclusive. An entry without turn numbers is not accepted.

node_active.description: Nodes live across the span, first-seen order, ;-joined; null for corpora.
